newsitem.title: USA: U.S. March T-bonds finish sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. March T-bonds finish sharply lower.

text.p: Dec 31 - U.S. March T-bonds ended sharply lower in an abbreviated session, hindered by nervousness after strong new home sales data early. Pits relatively thin after the early sell-off, buyers wary. One firm a buyer near the low of about 4,000 March to stanch losses, trader said. No trade Wednesday for the New Year's holiday.
